title: Lost Mary Nera15k Cola Prefilled Vape Pods
description: Designed for use with the Lost Mary Nera30K Fullview Prefilled Pod Kit, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods offer a seamless, flavour-packed vaping experience with up to 15,000 puffs per refill pack. Each replacement pod pack includes a 2ml built-in mesh coil pod prefilled with Lost Mary’s signature nic salt e-liquid (20mg), plus an innovative 10ml auto-refilling e-liquid container that keeps your pod topped up for longer-lasting satisfaction. Cola captures the classic, fizzy taste of a refreshing cola beverage, with rich caramel undertones and a crisp, effervescent finish. Every puff delivers a nostalgic and invigorating flavour, making this a favourite for fans of soda-inspired vapes. With an easy-to-use push-to-refill system, visible e-liquid level window, and high-performance mesh coil technology, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods provide a smooth and flavourful mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
